title: kb-sprint run gives a headless worker brief with a scratch dir, a turn cap by item kind and subshell-only cd
goal: Answers the SP-s5fdczv7 retrospective: the first headless worker had no scratch directory, so its proof script went to /tmp and its cleanup was refused; the goal research worker stopped at its 100-turn cap; and the orchestrator's own foreground cd into a worker worktree moved its session's working directory there. kb-sprint run step 3 gives the headless claude -p brief's fixed parts: a scratch directory passed with --add-dir and named in the brief for throwaway files, a --max-turns by item kind (research and investigation bugs higher than a one-file task), and that the orchestrator runs a command in a worker's worktree only in a subshell or with git -C, never a bare cd.

run: import sys;t=open('.claude/skills/kb-sprint/SKILL.md',encoding='utf-8').read();ok='--add-dir' in t and '--max-turns' in t and 'subshell' in t;print('headless brief template:',ok);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

gates.question: Which --max-turns per item kind, and where is a headless worker's scratch directory?
options: task 60, bug or untasked story 100, research or investigation bug 200; scratch _cache/scratch/<id>/ outside the worktree
one cap of 150 for every kind; the OS temp directory
gates.recommendation: task 60, bug or untasked story 100, research or investigation bug 200; scratch _cache/scratch/<id>/ outside the worktree
gates.answer: task 60, bug or untasked story 100, research or investigation bug 200; scratch _cache/scratch/<id>/ outside the worktree

notes: Premise (run 2026-10-07): its check prints False (--add-dir True, --max-turns False, subshell False); --add-dir is in SKILL.md only for .claude/ staging copies. The --max-turns flag works in this CLI though claude --help does not list it: a headless research session started with --max-turns 60 ended with subtype error_max_turns at 61 turns. kb DOC: kb/public/claude/ci-and-headless.md:39 (print mode, exits with error at the limit, no default).
